typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source h1,h2,h3,.wordmark.

recognitionRules: Use Archivo headlines with large open spacing around the proposition.
Let blue, yellow and mint form distinct fields rather than blended gradients.
Keep the work grid separate from engagement and service panels.
Make the enquiry area a clear next step after the scope is understood.

principles: Let a concrete image or material action carry the opening; explain the work plainly afterward.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Bring the brief. We will make the work and the working plan clear.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid abstract manifestos that displace the actual work.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Begin with one thing you can make or inspect.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use BRIGHT ASSEMBLY in Archivo with a small offset rectangular color block. Keep the block outside the letterforms and avoid a generic app tile.
invariants: Use Archivo headlines with large open spacing around the proposition.
Let blue, yellow and mint form distinct fields rather than blended gradients.
Keep the work grid separate from engagement and service panels.
adaptations: Use one color field per proposal section.
Reduce saturated fields in long reading documents while retaining the blue wordmark.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
